verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business phone-number service, so a programmatic SMS API with delivery-status callbacks is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no SMS send/receive API and no registrable delivery webhooks. The only developer API cited is the Workspace Admin Reports activities list, which is adjacent admin reporting and not messaging, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Community mentions of texting describe app and Chrome-extension use, not an API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
